hits.about: Tenora is a modern 10-storey project by Damac Properties located in the picturesque Dubai South neighborhood. The building is designed in a contemporary style using quality materials and the residences offer views of the cityscape.Tenora offers a wide range of fully furnished studios and 1 or 2 bedroom apartments, making life here comfortable and convenient. The availability of a swimming pool, equipped gym and sauna allows residents to keep fit and healthy. A children's playground pleases the little residents of the complex, and a barbecue area and a recreation area will be a great place for family gatherings and meetings with friends. A multifunctional hall allows you to hold various events. Landscaped gardens and a spacious parking lot create a pleasant environment for strolls and outdoor recreation. High-speed elevators provide easy access to the entire complex, and 24-hour security guarantees the safety of residents. First floor stores and community facilities make life easier for Tenora residents, allowing them to quickly store or enjoy a delicious meal without having to leave the complex. This array of amenities makes living at Tenora an ideal choice for those who value comfort and quality of life.Three of Dubai's key thoroughfares, Sheikh Zayed Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road, pass close to Tenora. Within 30 minutes are IMG Worlds of Adventure, Bollywood Parks Dubai theme park and Dubai Autodrome, a Formula 1 racing circuit.
hits.title: Tenora
